isSubmitting.description: Whether the form is being submitted.

isDirty.description: Whether the value of any field differs from the one it started with.

isError.description: Whether the last submit ended in an error.

getValues.description: The current values of the form.

getErrors.description: The errors of the invalid fields, by field name.

getDirty.description: The dirty fields, by field name.

getTouched.description: The touched fields, by field name.

getErrorText.description: The text of the error status of the form, `null` if there is none.

setErrorText.description: Sets the text of the error status. Pass `null` to remove it.

getSuccessText.description: The text of the success status of the form, `null` if there is none.

setSuccessText.description: Sets the text of the success status. Pass `null` to remove it.

clearStatusText.description: Removes the error and the success text.

getAllFields.description: Every field of the form, by name.

getField.description: The field with this name, `undefined` if the form has none.

getAction.description: The `action` of the form, an empty string if it has none.

reset.description: Resets the form to its initial state.

syncFields.description: Picks up fields that were added or removed after the form was hydrated.

renameField.description: Renames a field, keeping its value, touched, dirty and error state. Useful to keep the rows of a FieldArray contiguously indexed after one in the middle was removed.

id.description: The unique identifier of the form.

validation.description: Validates the values of the form on the client: a Standard Schema validator such as Zod, or a synchronous callback that gets the `values` and returns the errors by field name. It cannot be set from a Fluid template, only by constructing `Form` in your own entry file.

objectName.description: The object name that prefixes the names of nested form fields.

inputDebounceMs.description: How long the fields wait after the last change before they read their value, never less than 50. A `validate` that sends a request should not fire on every keystroke.

onSubmit.type: (({ values, api, event, post }: { values: FormValues; api: FormApi; event: JSX.FormEvent<HTMLElement>; post: (url: string) => Promise<Response>; }) => Promise<FormSubmitResult> | FormSubmitResult) | undefined
onSubmit.description: Called with the values once the form is valid and submitted. Return `true` for success, `false` for an error, or field errors to mark the form invalid. `post(url)` submits the form as `FormData` and maps a 422 JSON response to field errors for you.

render.description: Called every time the form state changes. Use it to update UI the form does not wire itself.

Root.data-state: The state of the form. One of: "invalid", "ready", "submitting", "success", "error".
Root.data-submitting: Present while the form is being submitted.
